Abhayudaan Foundation Abhayudaan Foundation is a non-profit organization committed to holistic development in rural areas. Our mission is to foster sustainable growth, promote social inclusivity, and empower communities for a brighter future. Join us in catalyzing change and creating lasting impact in villages. Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Skill Development Eco-system enabler Sports Art & Culture Senior Citizens Agriculture Animal & Wildlife Employment Water Sanitation Food & Nutrition Livelihoods Energy & Environment Disaster Management Education Health Child & Youth Development Housing Technology Recycling Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Secondary Sectors Civic Issues Health & Family Welfare Micro Finance - Self Help Groups Nutrition Poverty Scientific & Industrial Research Vocational Training Women Empowerment Youth Informal Education Teacher Training Formal Education Child Rights Girl Child Waste to Value Financials Geographies Served Programs Mission Arogya Mission Aarogya, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is a healthcare initiative dedicated to ensuring the overall well-being and healthcare access for every villager and living creature in rural communities. Our mission transcends traditional healthcare approaches, aiming to empower every member of the village community with access to quality healthcare services. Through comprehensive solutions including robust healthcare infrastructure, counseling and support services, emergency response initiatives, and promotion of healthy living, Mission Aarogya strives to address healthcare challenges and promote holistic development in rural areas. Join us in our movement to transform healthcare and promote well-being in rural communities. Mission Shakti Mission Shakti, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is dedicated to empowering girls and women in rural areas through comprehensive and transformative initiatives. Our mission transcends conventional approaches, aiming to secure, empower, counsel, and upskill women and girl children. By creating safe environments, providing access to education and vocational training, offering counseling and mentorship, and fostering skill development, we strive to create a more empowered and inclusive community where every woman and girl has the opportunity to thrive and contribute positively. Join us in our mission to make a lasting impact and create a brighter future for girls and women in rural communities. Mission Karuna Mission Karuna, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is a compassionate initiative dedicated to the preservation and care of animals, children, and senior citizens in rural communities. Our mission prioritizes their well-being and dignity through advocacy, awareness-raising, essential support, and accommodations. We empower individuals to become advocates for their rights and welfare through educational programs and engage with the community to foster a culture of compassion and support. Through collaboration with local organizations and stakeholders, Mission Karuna aims to create sustainable solutions for the preservation and care of the most vulnerable members of our society. Join us in our mission to preserve, protect, and care for animals, children, and senior citizens in rural communities. Mission Samriddhi Mission Samridhhi, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is dedicated to comprehensive infrastructure development in rural communities. We prioritize enhancing essential facilities such as roads, electricity, communication, housing, healthcare, and water sanitation systems to foster prosperity and well-being. Through strategic interventions and collaborative efforts, we aim to uplift rural areas, ensuring equitable access to essential services and improving the overall quality of life for residents. Join us in our mission to build resilient and prosperous rural communities where every individual thrives. Mission Udgam Mission Udgam, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is committed to revolutionizing education in rural communities through holistic initiatives. Our mission transcends conventional educational paradigms, aiming to empower every individual within the village. By focusing on comprehensive educational reforms, inclusive learning opportunities, upgraded infrastructure, counseling services, and innovative teaching methods, we strive to foster personal growth, socioeconomic progress, and community engagement. Through a holistic approach that encompasses academic, extracurricular, and life skills development, Mission Udgam endeavors to create a future where every member of the village community can realize their academic potential and contribute meaningfully to society. Join us in our movement to transform education and unlock the potential of rural communities. Mission Prakriti Mission Prakriti, driven by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is committed to preserving nature and nurturing the environment in rural areas. Our holistic approach focuses on conserving natural habitats, raising environmental awareness, enhancing green cover, and advocating for sustainable development practices. By fostering a deep connection with nature and promoting eco-friendly initiatives, we strive to create a harmonious relationship between humans and the environment. Join us in our mission to protect the beauty and biodiversity of our planet for present and future generations. Mission Sahyog Mission Sahyog, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is dedicated to providing essential emergency response services in rural communities, ensuring swift and effective assistance during times of crisis. From medical emergencies to natural disasters, we prioritize the safety and well-being of every individual, offering immediate medical care, coordinating disaster relief efforts, and empowering communities with life-saving skills. Through collaboration with stakeholders and continuous support, Mission Sahyog aims to build resilience and create safer, more resilient rural communities. Join us in our mission to save lives and make a lasting impact on those in need. Mission Sanskriti Mission Sanskriti, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, is dedicated to preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage and traditions of rural communities. Our mission encompasses various initiatives aimed at safeguarding traditional art forms, music, dance, folklore, and historical sites. Through vibrant cultural festivals, educational programs, and community events, we celebrate our cultural diversity and foster pride in our heritage. By documenting indigenous knowledge systems and facilitating cultural exchanges, Mission Sanskriti ensures the continuity and appreciation of our cultural legacy for future generations. Join us in our commitment to honoring, protecting, and promoting the rich tapestry of traditions that define our rural communities. Mission Udaan Mission Udaan, led by the Abhayudaan Foundation, soars beyond limits, empowering rural communities through sports, art, and creativity. Our mission transcends boundaries, fostering personal growth and community unity. Through sports tournaments, artistic workshops, and community events, we ignite passions, elevate talents, and inspire dreams, enriching lives and transforming futures. By championing the power of sports in fostering physical fitness, teamwork, and leadership, and celebrating artistic expression as a tool for self-expression and community development, Mission Udaan creates pathways for talent recognition and holistic development. Join us in our mission to uplift, empower, and transform lives through sports, art, and creativity. Impact Metrics Provided 20 Nutritional Kits.
